works.version: Wenqiang Zhang, University of Chinese Academy of Sciences doctoral dissertation, 2022
scope: PDF113–132 conclusion, bibliography and back matter
checks: PDF60 identifies AGFA and the shared recoil-tagging setup. The three nuclei are different products recorded in one acquisition.
PDF82 gives the 187Pb delayed 308-keV line and 5.15(15) microsecond fit. PDF97 gives the 188Bi 243-keV-conditioned 0.25(5) microsecond fit with a distinct combined-line comparison.
PDF102–103 Fig. 6.6 contains three events for 242 keV, two for 347 keV, and the author's background/significance treatment. The first 2+ interpretation also uses isotopic systematics.
works.gap: Low statistics, background choices and conditional shape assignments remain explicit. No separate replication credit for analyses of the same event stream.
works.lineage: Shared AGFA/Gammasphere acquisition with distinct tagging channels; primary spectra and model comparisons use different evidence roles.
